name: Family Favourites (Poland)
summary: Everyday dinners that Polish families with children cook during the week.

recipes.name: Kotlet schabowy (breaded pork cutlet) with potatoes and mizeria (cucumber salad)
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water.
Pound the pork with a meat mallet into thin cutlets; season with salt and pepper.
Coat the cutlets in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot fat for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden.
Slice the cucumbers thinly and mix with the soured cream, dill and salt.
Serve the cutlets with the potatoes sprinkled with dill and the mizeria.

recipes.name: Kotlety mielone (Polish pork patties) with beetroot
steps: Soak the roll in the milk and squeeze it out.
Grate the onion and mix with the meat, roll, egg, salt and pepper.
Shape into oval patties and coat them in breadcrumbs.
Fry over a medium heat for 5–6 minutes on each side.
Boil the potatoes; grate the beetroot and season with salt, a little sugar and vinegar.
Serve the patties with the potatoes and beetroot.

recipes.name: Gołąbki bez zawijania (unrolled cabbage rolls)
steps: Cook the rice until half done.
Finely chop the cabbage and onion and fry them in the oil until soft.
Mix the meat with the rice, cabbage, egg, salt, pepper and paprika.
Shape into oblong patties and brown them briefly on both sides.
Pour over the passata and stock, cover and simmer for approx. 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes and serve with the gołąbki and sauce.

recipes.name: Bigos (hunter's stew with sauerkraut and meat)
steps: Soak the mushrooms in hot water, then chop them.
Squeeze out and chop the sauerkraut and shred the white cabbage; cook both with the bay leaves and allspice for approx. 40 minutes.
Dice the meat, bacon and sausage and brown with the onion.
Add the meat, the mushrooms with their soaking water and the prunes to the cabbage.
Simmer over a low heat for approx. 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Season with the tomato purée, salt and pepper; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Meatballs in dill sauce
steps: Soak the roll in water, squeeze it out and mix with the meat, egg, grated onion, salt and pepper.
Bring the stock to the boil with the sliced carrot.
Shape into small balls and simmer them in the stock for approx. 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes.
Whisk the cream with the flour, pour into the stock and bring to the boil until the sauce thickens.
Add the chopped dill, season and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Pork goulash
steps: Dice the meat, dust with flour and brown in the oil.
Add the chopped onion, carrot and garlic and fry for a few minutes.
Stir in the sweet paprika, add the tomato purée and pour in the stock.
Cover and simmer for approx. 40 minutes.
Add the diced peppers and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper; serve with the potatoes and a raw vegetable salad.

recipes.name: Żurek (sour rye soup) with sausage and egg
ingredients: 300 g white or country-style kiełbasa (Polish sausage)
steps: Hard-boil the eggs and peel them.
Chop the bacon and fry it in a large saucepan.
Add the stock and diced potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage, pour in the żur and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, marjoram and soured cream; season with salt and pepper.
Serve with halved eggs and bread.

recipes.name: Łazanki (pasta squares) with sauerkraut and sausage
steps: Squeeze out and chop the sauerkraut, then cook it with the bay leaf for approx. 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta al dente.
Fry the onion and diced sausage in the oil.
Add the sliced mushrooms and fry until their liquid has evaporated.
Mix the sauerkraut, pasta and sausage; season with caraway, salt and pepper.
Heat everything together in the frying pan for a few minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Fasolka po bretońsku (Polish baked beans with sausage)
steps: Dice the bacon and sausage and fry in a large saucepan.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and fry until translucent.
Add the tomatoes, tomato purée, bay leaves and paprika.
Add the drained beans and simmer for approx. 20 minutes.
Season with marjoram, salt and pepper.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Pork loin in mushroom sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Cut the pork into thin slices, pound lightly, season with salt and dust with flour.
Brown the meat in the butter on both sides and set aside.
In the same pan, fry the onion and sliced mushrooms.
Pour in the stock and cream, return the meat and simmer for approx. 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Leczo (pepper and tomato stew) with sausage
steps: Cut the sausage into half-moons and fry in the oil.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and fry for a few minutes.
Add the diced peppers and courgette and simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour in the tomatoes and add the tomato purée and sweet paprika.
Simmer for another 15 minutes and season with salt and pepper; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Grochówka (split pea soup) with sausage
steps: Rinse the peas and simmer them in the stock for approx. 30 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and carrot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fry the onion with the sliced sausage in the butter.
Add the sausage to the soup and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with marjoram, salt and pepper; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Pasta bake with ham
ingredients: 200 g mild hard cheese (e.g. Gouda or Edam)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and cook the pasta al dente.
Fry the onion and garlic in the butter, then add the diced pepper and courgette.
Add the chopped ham, pour in the milk and cream and season.
Mix the sauce with the pasta and half of the grated cheese.
Transfer to an ovenproof dish, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve with a green salad.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, reserving a cup of the cooking water.
Cut the bacon into strips and fry in the olive oil until crisp.
Mix the egg yolks and egg with the grated Parmesan and pepper.
Tip the drained pasta into the pan with the bacon and take it off the heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir quickly, adding a little pasta water, until a creamy sauce forms.

recipes.name: Chinese-style pork
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the meat into strips and coat in the starch mixed with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Cut the vegetables into thin strips.
Sear the meat in very hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables with the garlic and ginger for 4–5 minutes.
Add the meat, the remaining soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar and a splash of water; cook until the sauce thickens and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers
steps: Cook the rice and preheat the oven to 190°C.
Fry the onion and garlic, add the meat and fry until no longer pink.
Mix the meat with the rice, tomato purée, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds and fill with the stuffing.
Arrange the peppers in a dish on top of the tinned tomatoes, cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and bake for another 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef goulash with kasza (barley or buckwheat groats)
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley or buckwheat groats
steps: Dice the beef, dust with flour and brown in batches in the oil.
Fry the bacon, onion, leek and garlic.
Add the meat, sweet paprika and stock; cover and simmer for approx. 1.5 hours.
Add the pepper and mushrooms and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the groats.
Season the goulash with salt and pepper; serve with the groats and fermented dill pickles.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic; fry in the olive oil.
Add the meat and fry, breaking up any lumps.
Pour in the tomatoes and add the tomato purée and milk.
Simmer over a low heat for approx. 25 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Cook the spaghetti al dente.
Serve the pasta with the sauce and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Lasagne
ingredients: 100 g Parmesan or mild hard cheese
steps: Fry the onion, carrot and garlic, then add the meat and brown it.
Pour in the passata, add the tomato purée and simmer the sauce for 20 minutes.
Melt the butter, add the flour and gradually pour in the milk, stirring, until you have a thick béchamel; season with nutmeg.
Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Layer in a dish: meat sauce, pasta, béchamel; repeat and finish with béchamel and cheese.
Bake for approx. 40 minutes and leave to rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the meat and fry until browned.
Add the spices, the diced pepper and the tomatoes.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add the drained beans and sweetcorn and cook for another 10 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with the chilli, keeping it mild for children.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the beef into thin strips, dust with flour and sear in the oil; set aside.
Fry the onion, pepper and mushrooms.
Add the tomato purée, mustard and stock and bring to the boil.
Add the meat and the pickles cut into strips; simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Homemade burgers
steps: Bake the oven chips according to the packet instructions.
Divide the meat into 4, shape into flat patties and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the patties in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes on each side, adding the cheese towards the end.
Halve and toast the buns.
Assemble the burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and gherkin; serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Tacos with minced beef
steps: Fry the chopped onion and garlic.
Add the meat and fry, breaking up any lumps.
Season with cumin, paprika, salt and a splash of water; cook for 5 minutes.
Chop the tomatoes, lettuce and avocado.
Warm the tortillas and serve so everyone can add their own meat, vegetables, cheese and soured cream.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the beef into thin strips and mix with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the cornflour.
Break the broccoli into florets and blanch for 2 minutes.
Sear the meat in batches in very hot oil and set aside.
Fry the garlic and ginger, then add the broccoli, meat, remaining soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Toss until the sauce coats everything and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash them with the milk and butter.
Fry the onion and grated carrot, then add the meat and brown it.
Add the tomato purée, stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 15 minutes; add the peas towards the end.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Transfer the meat to an ovenproof dish, cover with the mash and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden on top.

recipes.name: Rosół (Polish chicken soup) with noodles
ingredients: 1 chicken or 1.5 kg chicken soup pieces
steps: Put the chicken in a large pan, cover with approx. 3 l cold water and bring slowly to the boil, skimming off the scum.
Char the onion over a flame or in a dry frying pan.
Add the peeled vegetables, onion and spices.
Simmer over a very low heat for approx. 2 hours, adding salt towards the end.
Cook the noodles separately.
Strain the soup and serve with the noodles, carrot and parsley.

recipes.name: Kotlety de volaille (chicken Kiev)
steps: Mix the butter with the garlic and herbs, shape into a log and chill.
Pound the fillets into thin escalopes and season with salt and pepper.
Place a piece of the butter on each one and roll up tightly.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs, ideally twice.
Deep-fry for approx. 10 minutes until golden.
Serve with the potatoes and a raw vegetable salad.

recipes.name: Chicken in cream sauce
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the chicken into pieces, season with salt, dust with flour and brown in the butter.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and fry for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in the stock and cream and simmer for 8–10 minutes.
Add the grated Parmesan, season and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Roast chicken drumsticks with potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Rub the drumsticks with oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Cut the potatoes, carrots and leek into chunks and toss with oil and salt.
Spread the vegetables in a roasting tin, place the drumsticks on top and add the garlic, lemon slices and rosemary.
Roast for approx. 50 minutes until the skin is crisp.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and brown in the oil.
Add the onion and garlic, stir in the curry powder and fry for a minute.
Add the vegetables and a little water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Pour in the cream, bring to the boil and season with salt and lime juice.
Serve with the rice and parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla wraps
steps: Cut the chicken into strips, season with salt and coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry the strips in oil until golden.
Chop the vegetables and grate the cheese.
Mix the mayonnaise with the ketchup.
Warm the tortillas, spread with the sauce, add the vegetables, cheese and chicken and roll up.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken, coat in 1 tbsp of the starch and brown in the oil.
Add the chopped vegetables and garlic and fry for 5 minutes.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, pineapple juice and the remaining starch.
Pour in the sauce, add the pineapple and cook until thickened.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Homemade chicken nuggets with chips
ingredients: 600 g chicken thigh or breast fillets
1 carrot and 1 apple for the salad
steps: Bake the oven chips according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and paprika.
Coat the pieces in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil for 2–3 minutes on each side.
Grate the carrot and apple for the salad.
Serve the nuggets with the chips, salad and ketchup.

recipes.name: Chicken risotto
steps: Dice the chicken, season with paprika and brown in the olive oil; set aside.
Fry the onion, add the rice and fry for a minute.
Add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring, for approx. 18 minutes.
Halfway through, add the diced peppers.
Stir in the chicken, butter and Parmesan, season and serve.

recipes.name: Zupa ogórkowa (dill pickle soup) with chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for approx. 15 minutes, then remove and chop it.
Add the diced potatoes and carrot to the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fry the onion, add the grated pickles and cook gently for a few minutes.
Add the pickles to the soup along with the chicken and pickle brine.
Temper the soured cream with a little hot soup, stir it into the pan and add the dill.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Chicken goulash
steps: Dice the chicken, dust with flour and brown in the oil.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic and fry for a few minutes.
Add the diced peppers, tomatoes, sweet paprika and oregano.
Cover and simmer for approx. 20 minutes.
Cook the rice or groats and serve with the goulash.

recipes.name: Tomato soup with pasta
ingredients: 4 chicken drumsticks or chicken soup pieces
steps: Cover the chicken with 2.5 l water, bring to the boil and skim off the scum.
Add the peeled vegetables and simmer over a low heat for approx. 40 minutes.
Remove the meat and vegetables, add the tomato purée to the broth and bring to the boil.
Temper the soured cream with a little hot soup and stir it into the pan; season.
Cook the pasta and serve with the soup and parsley.

recipes.name: Ryba po grecku (fried fish with carrot and tomato topping)
ingredients: 600 g white fish fillets (cod or pollock)
steps: Grate the carrots and parsley root and chop the onion.
Cook the vegetables gently in 2 tbsp of the oil with the bay leaves for approx. 15 minutes.
Add the tomato purée and water, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cut the fish into pieces, season with salt, coat in flour and fry.
Boil the potatoes.
Arrange the fish on plates, cover with the vegetables and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Breaded fish with potatoes
ingredients: oil or clarified butter for frying
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Cut the fish into portions and season with salt and pepper.
Dip the fish in the egg beaten with the milk and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden.
Mix the chopped sauerkraut with the grated carrot and a little oil.
Serve the fish with the dill potatoes, the salad and lemon.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with leek and cherry tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes.
Cut the leek into half-moons and spread in a dish with the olive oil.
Place the salmon on the leek, season with salt and pepper and drizzle with lemon juice.
Add the tomatoes and knobs of butter.
Bake for approx. 15–18 minutes.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Fish cakes
steps: Soak the roll in the milk and squeeze it out.
Mince or finely chop the fish with the onion.
Mix with the roll, egg, dill, salt and pepper.
Shape into patties and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry for 4 minutes on each side; serve with the potatoes and a raw vegetable salad.

recipes.name: Pasta with tuna
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Fry the garlic in the olive oil, add the halved tomatoes and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the drained tuna and olives and heat through.
Toss with the pasta, a little of the cooking water and the lemon juice.
Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Pierogi ruskie (potato and cheese dumplings)
ingredients: 300 g semi-skimmed twaróg (Polish curd cheese, or quark)
steps: Boil the potatoes and press them through a ricer.
Fry the onions in the butter until translucent; mix half with the potatoes, twaróg, salt and pepper.
Knead a dough from the flour, hot water, oil and a pinch of salt.
Roll out thinly, cut out rounds, add the filling and seal the edges well.
Cook the pierogi in batches in salted water for 2–3 minutes after they rise to the surface.
Serve with the remaining onion, soured cream and a raw vegetable salad.

recipes.name: Naleśniki z serem (pancakes with sweet curd cheese)
ingredients: 500 g twaróg (Polish curd cheese, or quark)
steps: Blend the flour, milk, water, eggs, oil and salt into a smooth batter.
Fry thin pancakes in a lightly greased frying pan.
Mash the twaróg with a fork together with the soured cream, icing sugar and vanilla sugar.
Spread the pancakes with the cheese mixture and roll up or fold into triangles.
Fry briefly in butter and serve, e.g. with fruit or soured cream.

recipes.name: Placki ziemniaczane (potato pancakes)
steps: Peel the potatoes and onion and grate them finely.
Pour off the excess liquid.
Add the eggs, flour, salt and pepper and mix.
Spoon portions into the hot oil and flatten them.
Fry for 3 minutes on each side until crisp.
Serve with soured cream or sugar and a raw vegetable salad.

recipes.name: Kopytka (Polish potato dumplings)
ingredients: 1 carrot and 1 apple for the salad
steps: Boil the potatoes, press through a ricer and leave to cool.
Add the flour, egg and salt and quickly knead into a dough.
Shape into logs and cut them diagonally into kopytka.
Cook in batches in salted water for approx. 2 minutes after they rise to the surface.
Brown the breadcrumbs in the butter and pour over the kopytka.
Serve with a carrot and apple salad.

recipes.name: Leniwe (lazy curd cheese dumplings)
ingredients: 500 g semi-skimmed twaróg (Polish curd cheese, or quark)
steps: Mash the twaróg with a fork.
Add the eggs, salt and flour and knead briefly into a dough.
Shape into logs, flatten slightly and cut diagonally.
Cook in salted water for approx. 2 minutes after they rise to the surface.
Pour over the butter with the browned breadcrumbs and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Pasta with spinach
steps: Cook the pasta al dente.
Fry the onion and garlic in the olive oil and butter.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour in the cream, bring to the boil and add the grated Parmesan.
Toss with the pasta and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Pizza margherita
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, water and olive oil and knead into a smooth dough.
Leave in a warm place for approx. 30 minutes.
Blend the tomatoes with the oregano and a pinch of salt.
Preheat the oven to its highest setting and roll out the dough onto 2 baking trays.
Spread with the sauce, top with the mozzarella and bake for 10–12 minutes.
Sprinkle with basil and serve.

recipes.name: Spinach with fried eggs and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp of the butter until translucent.
Add the spinach and cook until the water has evaporated.
Pour in the soured cream and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Fry the eggs in the remaining butter.
Serve the spinach with the eggs and potatoes.
